text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright, you're definitely, absoluuutely 
going to take the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa... Big sister Ryan? You're soooo 
confident and bold, aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Nippon Derby, the greatest climax 
of the Classic Triple Crown, right around 
the corner, Mejiro Ryan was brimming with 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm feeling confident! After 
all, Tokyo's 2400m is the perfect course 
for Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It has the longest home stretch of any 
racetrack! I can make the absolute most of 
my prized late burst!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, the course is wide, so she won't 
get boxed in! As long as she runs a normal 
lap..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan is delighted, but...
choice_data_list: Maybe I'm being a bit too optimistic.
Maybe I'm being a bit too optimistic, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Optimistic, you say... Is there 
something worrying you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I voiced my concerns. While the course 
certainly suits Mejiro Bright, the worry 
remains that she cannot dictate the pace 
of the race herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back during the Satsuki Sho, there were 
some pretty formidable front-runners too. 
If I'd put too much faith in her late 
burst and just let them run free...
choice_data_list:
You might end up paying dearly for this, 
you know?

You might end up paying dearly for this, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Urk! That's true~... There was an 
Umamusume who caught my eye. Kind of like 
Ines...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It might be dangerous to completely ignore 
the Front Runners and Leaders... There are 
rare Derbies where a Front Runner takes it 
all the way, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed~. Sister Ryan's year unfolded in 
just that manner...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Do you remember, Bright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course~ After all, the one who pulled 
off that front-running victory was 
Ryan-oneesama's dear classmate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the one who conquered that year's 
Derby was Mejiro Ryan's roommate, Ines 
Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, my old wounds are aching~... I was 
so frustrated back then, really...! But!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Not letting past wounds just end as 
wounds, but using them for 
supercompensation—that's the true spirit 
of muscle training!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's take the lessons from back 
then and put them to use for Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, I'll go call them right 
over!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me, Ryan-oneesama?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan dashed off at incredible speed 
and returned in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo, Bright-chan♪ I came over to 
hang out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Wah, Lady Ines~. I am so, veeeery happy to 
meet you~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Ryan-chan is always talking to me 
about Bright-chan anyway!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm doting on them so much it hurts! It's 
absolute, unconditional LOVE!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
S-Stop it, Ines~. Come on, that's 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, training began with Ines Fujin 
joining as a pacing partner.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heheh, Bright-chan, follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*yawn*... They are pulling further and 
further ahead~ I suppose I ought to give 
chase a little earlier...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada...!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe, that's falling right into my 
trap! Now for the final stretch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooooosh!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, my legs... won't move~?! Even 
though... I can usually close in...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant* Trainer, this is...
choice_data_list: I see, so they’re your natural enemy, huh…
I see, so they’re your arch-nemesis, huh…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Natural enemy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are many types of Front Runners, 
but... Ines Fujin was the kind who could 
completely dominate the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seize the pace from the start, build up 
power in the middle while keeping an eye 
behind, and completely empty the tank at 
the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In short—it was the worst possible 
matchup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said, Trainer, they really are 
our natural enemy. For late-stretch 
closers like me and Bright, that's 
undeniably true...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run from the side like 
this... makes it very clear to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So that's what it was~. Still, I'm very 
glad you were able to run in advance~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If Lady Ines were to teach me, I believe I 
would be able to prepare thoroughly for 
the real thing, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! I think it'll make for the 
best training! If it's for Ryan-chan's 
little sis, I'll help as much as you need!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ines. That's a big help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"To receive a helping hand like this must 
be another power of the Mejiro name, 
mustn't it~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Not only the Mejiro Umamusume, but 
everyone who interacted with the family as 
well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ines-sama, I shall devote my heart to you 
from now on~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's so reassuring~ It feels as though 
I've gained two more big sisters!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Leave the big sister role to me! 
I've got two little sisters at home, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, Bright-chan, Ryan-chan, 
let's run. Trainer, please watch over us!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, let's try out different race 
strategies.
Yeah, let's try out different tactics.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With our eyes set on the decisive battle, 
we ran simulated Derbys over and over. 
With this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our preparations for the main event are 
foolproof. We should be able to handle 
even a powerful Front Runner.
